I've looked at three so far, shortlist below

1. Marlowe & Vine, Great Portland St. Private room for up to 12, set menu ~£55pp + service. Needs min spend £500
2. Fenwick Kitchen, Mortimer St. Upstairs room seats 10-14, a la carte, roughly £45-60pp. No min spend, they said
3. Bellamy's, Eastcastle St. Room for 8 only so would need to split, ~£50pp. Too tight imo
